messages.content: Decide whether one authoritative source unit contains an internal narrative transition strong enough to justify splitting that unit across two large H3 chapters. Return valid JSON only.

SOURCE UNIT:
One final measurement resolves the problem, the scientist closes the lab, and she leaves to meet her colleague.

A split is appropriate only if the unit itself crosses from one major narrative phase into another. A single terminal-resolution sequence may remain together.

Choose one decision from: SPLIT, KEEP_TOGETHER.
Return a JSON object with keys "decision" and "reason".
